identity.title: Fix PIXELPERMM unit and finite conversion contract

origin.kind: scheduled 2D task execution and source review
origin.summary: 2D-014 identified that the legacy PIXELPERMM name represents mm/px at runtime, while positive-only checks allowed infinity and multiplication overflow could publish non-finite millimeter metrics.

state.current_summary: The existing legacy PIXELPERMM key remains unchanged and is documented as millimeters per pixel. VisionPipelineMetricEnrichmentService now owns finite-positive scale and finite-product conversion for overlay, geometry, circle, distance, and curve metrics; direct LineDistance, CurveBandProfile, GapEdgePair, PinArrayGap, and InspectionAlgorithm paths reuse that owner. Shared pipeline validation rejects non-finite or negative scale parameters while preserving PIXELPERMM=0 as intentional pixel-only state. Focused unit, overflow, XML, validator, acceptance, prevalidation, and Debug build evidence passed.

claims.text: The previous ResolvePixelPerMm and direct metric paths used a positive-only check, so +Infinity could pass and finite scale multiplication could overflow to a non-finite mm metric.

problem.impact: Invalid calibration could produce meaningless physical-unit results or misleading acceptance inputs instead of a clear pixel-only/invalid boundary.

criteria.text: The public PIXELPERMM XML name and legacy mm/px meaning remain unchanged, and 100 px at 0.01 mm/px yields 1 mm across Line, Bounds, Circle, Geometry, Distance, and Curve metric families.
NaN, positive/negative infinity, zero, negative scales, and finite-product overflow publish no new millimeter metric; zero remains an intentional pixel-only state.

The shared pipeline Validator rejects non-finite or negative PIXELPERMM, LeftPIXELPERMM, and RightPIXELPERMM values before execution while existing finite acceptance and prevalidation contracts remain passing.
Legacy PIXELPERMM survives XML save/reopen without key or value migration.
The changed application and smoke projects build with zero errors, the focused contract dispatch is runnable, and no Original repository or external system is mutated.
Completion evidence records the current owners, actual call path, mutable-state writers, public/XML contract, shortest reading order, focused checks, and remaining runtime/UI boundary.

context.location: VisionPipelineMetricEnrichmentService owns shared pixel-to-mm conversion; VisionPipelineValidation owns pipeline admission; VisionPipelineLineDistanceTool, VisionPipelineCurveBandProfileTool, VisionPipelineGapEdgePairTool, VisionPipelinePinArrayGapTool, and InspectionAlgorithm reuse the conversion owner; SerializeHelper owns XML persistence.
VisionPipelineStep.Parameters writes the serialized scale; tool execution writes VisionToolResult.Metrics; enrichment writes derived mm metrics; Validator writes only validation errors/warnings.

VisionPipelineMetricEnrichmentService.cs -> VisionPipelineValidation.cs -> direct metric tool call sites -> VisionPipelineExecutionService.Enrich call -> PixelPerMmFiniteUnitContract.cs -> stable contract and current handoff.

This is a source/core and deterministic smoke contract. Actual WPF rendered calibration display, desktop EXE monitor placement, theme/DPI/input rows, camera/hardware qualification, and physical metrology certification remain unverified.

artifacts.summary: Focused conversion report, legacy XML round-trip, acceptance/prevalidation regression reports, and current Debug build outputs.

evidence.observation: Source review confirmed the legacy runtime meaning is mm/px and found positive-only scale checks plus direct multiplication in the shared enrichment and direct tool owners. The patch keeps the XML key, adds finite scale/product conversion once, and routes every identified direct conversion through it.

The focused contract passed 5/0: 100 px at 0.01 mm/px converted Line/Bounds/Circle/Geometry/Distance/Curve metrics, invalid and overflow scales published no mm metric, Validator rejected non-finite/negative values while zero stayed pixel-only, and legacy XML round-tripped.
The existing finite acceptance contract passed 10/0 and the shared Runner prevalidation contract exited 0 after the scale validation change.
The saved XML contains the unchanged public PIXELPERMM key with value 0.01 and reopened successfully.

OpenVisionLab Debug and Release builds completed with 0 warnings and 0 errors. VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke Debug and Release builds completed with 0 errors and 16 nullable warnings, including one in the new contract and the existing Preview equivalence warnings.
The stable contract and live handoff record the mm/px meaning, finite/overflow behavior, owner map, smoke command, evidence path, and unverified UI/hardware boundary.

events.summary: Resolve the shared finite unit conversion boundary, route direct metric owners through it, validate non-finite/negative legacy scales, preserve zero pixel-only behavior and XML compatibility, and close after focused 5/0 plus regression/build evidence.
